Example AI Infrastructure Launch

Example Labs launched Router One today for production AI applications.

The service routes requests across 400 models and currently handles more than ten trillion tokens every day for ten million developers.

Chief engineer Ada Example said the system chooses providers based on reliability, latency, and customer preferences rather than ownership.

The company reported tenfold annual growth and a team of ninety people. Existing API endpoints and routing policies will remain unchanged after the launch.

This matters because model routing has become a critical layer between application developers and a rapidly changing collection of inference providers.

Customers can continue using the same authentication keys, dashboards, and usage controls. A new regional failover mode will roll out next month.
